abstract: BACKGROUND: Ovarian choriocarcinoma (CC) is rarely encountered as compared to uterine CC. Furthermore, ovarian CC coexisting with surface epithelial tumor is very rare. CASE: A 50-year-old postmenopausal woman, gravida 0, was admitted to our hospital with abdominal pain and distention due to a complex ovarian tumor. The laboratory data showed high serum level of CA125, neuron specific enolase (NSE), and hCG beta-subunit C-terminal peptide (hCG-beta-CTP). Total abdominal hysterectomy, right salpingoophorectomy, and lymph node dissection were performed. The right ovary revealed a cystic tumor with two solid parts: larger part, endometrioid adenocarcinoma and small cell carcinoma; smaller part, predominantly CC and focally clear cell adenocarcinoma. CA125 was rapidly decreased after first operation, but hCG-beta-CTP levels repeated distinctive fluctuations and NSE abruptly increased during the last few months before death. The patient died 10 months after the first operation. CONCLUSION: Only four cases of ovarian nongestational CC coexisting with surface epithelial tumor have been reported. This is the first reported case of admixture of CC with three epithelial malignancies. We assume that endometrioid and clear cell adenocarcinomas arose at different sites as tumorigenic factors in association with endometriosis, and the former may have been dedifferentiated into small cell carcinoma and the latter to CC. Coexistence of CC with small cell carcinoma is considered to be responsible for relative chemoresistance leading to poor prognosis.
abstract_ja: 背景：卵巣絨毛癌は子宮の絨毛癌に比べてまれである。さらに、卵巣絨毛癌が表層上皮性腫瘍と併存することは非常にまれである。症例：50歳の閉経後女性（妊娠歴なし）が、腹痛と腹部膨満を主訴に入院した。複雑な卵巣腫瘍を認めた。検査所見では、CA125、神経特異的エノラーゼ（NSE）、hCGβサブユニットC末端ペプチド（hCG-β-CTP）の血清値が高値であった。全腹式子宮摘出術、右卵管卵巣摘出術、リンパ節郭清術を施行した。右卵巣は、二つの充実性部分を伴う嚢胞性腫瘍であった。大きい部分は類内膜腺癌と小細胞癌、小さい部分は主に絨毛癌と限局的な明細胞腺癌であった。CA125は初回手術後に急速に低下したが、hCG-β-CTPは明らかな変動を繰り返し、NSEは死亡前の数か月間に急激に上昇した。患者は初回手術から10か月後に死亡した。結論：表層上皮性腫瘍を伴う卵巣非妊娠性絨毛癌の報告はこれまで4例のみである。本症例は絨毛癌が3種の上皮性悪性腫瘍と混在した初めての報告である。類内膜腺癌と明細胞腺癌は子宮内膜症を背景に異なる部位で発生し、前者は小細胞癌へ、後者は絨毛癌へ脱分化した可能性があると考える。絨毛癌と小細胞癌の併存は化学療法抵抗性を生じ、予後不良の原因と考えられる。
